description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all . 
 Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
 
 As our Software AI Platform Services Engineer, you'll be a key part of keeping our AI platforms running reliably. This is a hands-on role blending troubleshooting and root cause analysis, AI-enabled operations, and platform support. You will work with end users, application owners, AI enablement innovation teams, and firmware integration points to improve operations. If you enjoy solving problems across software, automation, and integration, this role lets your work directly advance our most meaningful achievements! 

 This role will report to the Senior Manager, IT AI Platforms Service Management, and help provide reliable support for enterprise technology platforms, including ServiceNow, Azure, Power Platform, UiPath, integrations involving Claude and CoPilot, APIs, and automation services.vices. You will troubleshoot L2-L4 technical issues, own incidents and service requests through resolution, collaborate across engineering teams and vendors, and provide responsive, white-glove support to internal customers. You will help improve our operations by enhancing documentation and encouraging clear communication. You will identify recurring issues and trends and support the team in delivering reliable services that meet our SLA commitments. 
 


 Responsibilities: 
 Provide support for enterprise platforms and services, including ServiceNow, Azure, Microsoft Power Platform, UiPath, APIs, Claude and Copilot integrations, and automation. 
 Own incidents and service requests from triage through resolution. Stay accountable even when resolution needs other engineering teams, vendors, or domain experts. 
 Diagnose complex issues across applications, integrations, infrastructure, authentication, configurations, and platform dependencies to find root causes and solutions. Use logs, monitoring and diagnostic tools, knowledge bases, documentation, and vendor resources to investigate independently. 
 Give internal customers responsive, white-glove support with clear communication and timely updates. 
 Manage work to established SLAs, priorities, and operational expectations. Proactively identify and call out risks. 
 Work with engineering teams, platform owners, vendors, and other support teams to drive issues to resolution. Take part in incident management and handling customer concerns related to business-impacting issues. 
 Document troubleshooting steps, solutions, and known issues. Help create and improve knowledge articles, runbooks, and operational procedures. 
 Identify recurring incidents, support trends, and opportunities for automation, documentation, training, or process improvements that reduce repeat issues and improve reliability. Share technical knowledge and troubleshooting approaches with teammates. 
 


 Minimum Qualifications: 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. 5+ years supporting and troubleshooting enterprise applications, integrations, automation platforms, or infrastructure systems. 
 Experience triaging, troubleshooting, and resolving L2-L4 incidents and service requests in an ITSM platform such as ServiceNow. This includes working to SLAs and bringing up issues to engineering teams and vendors. 
 Working knowledge of automation and AI-enabled tools used in IT environments, such as generative AI assistants, Power Platform, or UiPath. 
 Working knowledge of APIs, system integrations, authentication, and cloud platforms such as Azure, enough to troubleshoot issues across them. 
 Clear verbal and written communication with engineers and business collaborators, and effective collaboration with engineering teams and vendors. 
 


 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Experience with Event Management, AIOps, Discovery, CMDB, and Service Mapping. Certifications are a plus. 
 Experience with LLM orchestration, agent frameworks, Model Context Protocol, retrieval-based solutions, and agent evaluation. This includes delivering ML, generative AI, or agentic AI solutions into production IT environments, ideally on major cloud AI platforms. 
 Experience with enterprise monitoring tools such as Splunk, AppDynamics, Dynatrace, OpsRamp, or SAP Solution Manager. This covers event management, alert correlation, and integrating operational platforms with those tools. 
 Familiarity with AI risk, governance, and responsible use of AI tools. Experience in semiconductor, manufacturing IT, or operational technology environments. 
 Contributing to AIOps or IT operations improvement initiatives, mentoring teammates, and participating in process improvement and information exchange. 
 
 
 As a world leader in the semiconductor industry, Micron is dedicated to your personal wellbeing and professional growth. Micron benefits are designed to help you stay well, provide peace of mind and help you prepare for the future.  We offer a choice of medical, dental and vision plans in all locations enabling team members to select the plans that best meet their family healthcare needs and budget.  Micron also provides benefit programs that help protect your income if you are unable to work due to illness or injury, and paid family leave.  Additionally, Micron benefits include a robust paid time-off program and paid holidays.   For additional information regarding the Benefit programs available, please see the Benefits Guide posted on micron.com/careers/benefits . 
 
 Micron is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, citizenship status, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.
 
 To learn about your right to work click here.

 Micron Prohibits the use of child labor and complies with all applicable laws, rules, regulations, and other international and industry labor standards.
 
 Micron does not charge candidates any recruitment fees or unlawfully collect any other payment from candidates as consideration for their employment with Micron.

However, all information provided must be accurate and reflect the candidate's true skills and experiences. Misuse of AI to fabricate or misrepresent qualifications will result in immediate disqualification.
